    • isReplaceable

      default boolean isReplaceable()
      Whether the amount this execution left unfilled may be placed on the exchange again. Only an order in a final state proves it may: the exchange has spoken its last word on it (filled, cancelled, expired — or rejected, which is how a placement the exchange itself refused is recorded), so whatever it filled is already accounted for and the unfilled remainder is real.

      An execution still holding a non-final order — or holding none at all, as when a placement request failed in transport and its outcome was never learned — may yet fill on the exchange, and placing its amount again risks ending up with double the intended position. Callers that can consult the exchange should reconcile first (reconcile(OrderExecutor)) so this decision is taken on REST truth rather than on the last event received.

      Returns:
      true if the unfilled amount is safe to place again

    • reconcile

      default Optional<org.knowm.xchange.dto.Order> reconcile(@NonNull @NonNull OrderExecutor executor)
      Reconciles this execution against the exchange's REST-side truth: looks up the order's current server state via OrderExecutor.findOrder(Instrument, String) and adopts it. If the true state is final, the execution terminates with that outcome — including recording any fill the event stream failed to deliver — instead of trusting the last stream echo. The default is a no-op returning the current order, for implementations that have no exchange to consult.
      Parameters:
      executor - the order executor providing the REST order lookup
      Returns:
      the current (possibly reconciled) order
